profile.ja: 上忍。ふうま八将が一角・二車家を支える幹部。初代ふうま小太郎から仕えていると言われていて、事実であれば五百年は生きている事になる。ふうま一門によくみられる邪眼使い。比丘尼の邪眼“人魚の碧眼”は、右眼で見たものの生命エネルギーを吸い取り、自らのエネルギーにしてしまう。生命エネルギーを奪われ尽くした対象は半魚人のような異形の怪物に変化するという。
profile.en: She is a high-ranking ninja and a key officer supporting the Ikkaku and Nisha households of the Fuuma Hachijo. It is said that she has been serving since the time of the first Fuuma Kotaro, which would mean she has been alive for over 500 years. She is a wielder of the evil eye, a trait commonly found among the Fuuma clan. Bikuni's evil eye, "the Azure Eye of the Mermaid," can drain the life energy of anything it sees with her right eye, converting it into her own energy. Targets that have their life energy completely drained are said to transform into monstrous creatures resembling merfolk.

text.ja: これはこれは“目抜け”のご当主様。この八百比丘尼を従えようというのですか？　ふふ、お戯れを……
text.en: Well, well, well - if it isn't our Master. You're thinking of making this Bikuni Yao yours, are you? Ha ha, how amusing...

text.ja: 未熟者に、異国の者、魔の者までいるとは……当主様の目抜けぶりには感心いたします
text.en: I must say, I'm impressed by your eclectic taste, Master - an immature one, a foreigner, and even a demon...

text.ja: 骸佐様は何をお考えなのでしょうか……この程度の者を相手に……
text.en: I wonder what Lady Nisha Gaiza is thinking, condescending to deal with someone like this...

text.ja: ふうまの宗家……まこと忌々しい事で御座います。あら？　聞こえていましたか？
text.en: The main house of the Fuuma... how detestable. Oh, were you eavesdropping?

text.ja: 女人に年を聞くのは御法度……古来よりの不文律ですよご当主様？
text.en: Asking a woman her age is strictly forbidden, Master - it's an ancient unwritten rule.

text.ja: 私の事を詮索されるよりも、ご自身の研鑽に当てられる方がよろしいでしょう
text.en: Rather than prying into my affairs, perhaps you should focus on your own training, Master.

text.ja: 私は二車家の者です。あまり当主面されますと……おっと、これはご無礼を
text.en: I am a member of the Nisha household. If I were to face our Master too often... oh dear, I'm being rude.

text.ja: 宗家のご当主様がどの程度の者なのか、見届けさせて頂こうと思っていますよ
text.en: I'd like to see for myself what kind of person our Master is, and I intend to do just that.
